title: Specification Testing for Dyadic Regression Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.26366v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops omnibus specification tests for linear conditional-mean models with undirected dyadic data. We establish a uniform projection theorem that reduces the dyadic process to its latent first-order node projections under shared-node dependence. We then show that a raw first-order node-multiplier bootstrap is valid when this node component is nondegenerate but double-counts dyad-specific variation when dyads are independent. An exact covariance decomposition motivates a corrected Gaussian bootstrap that is valid in both regimes. The resulting Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Cram\'er-von Mises tests are consistent against fixed alternatives and have nontrivial power against rate-appropriate local alternatives. Simulations show that the corrected Kolmogorov-Smirnov test provides the most stable size control while retaining substantial local power. An application to the Lazega law-firm network rejects additive linear and quadratic s

translated_title: 二元回归模型的设定检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.26366v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：本文针对无向二元数据下的线性条件均值模型，开发了全包式设定检验。我们建立了一个均匀投影定理，该定理在共享节点依赖下将二元过程简化为其潜在的一阶节点投影。随后，我们证明了当节点分量非退化时，原始的一阶节点乘子自助法有效，但在二元组独立时会重复计算二元组特有的变异。精确的协方差分解激发了一种修正的高斯自助法，该方法在两种情形下均有效。由此得到的Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验和Cramér-von Mises检验对固定备择假设具有一致性，并对速率适当的局部备择假设具有非平凡功效。模拟显示，修正的Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验在保持显著局部功效的同时，提供了最稳定的尺度控制。将该方法应用于Lazega律师事务所网络，拒绝了可加线性与二次模型设定。
tldr: 本文提出了针对二元回归模型的稳健设定检验方法，通过修正高斯自助法有效处理共享节点依赖，并提供了对固定与局部备择假设均有良好功效的检验工具。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes robust specification tests for dyadic regression models, using a corrected Gaussian bootstrap to handle shared-node dependence, with good power against both fixed and local alternatives.
